concerns.text: Task T011b (Shakespeare downloader) is scheduled in Phase 3 (US1) but contradicts the plan.md which explicitly excludes Shakespeare due to lack of a verified source. This task has no valid producer (verified dataset) and will fail execution, violating the 'Producer before consumer' and 'Foundational tasks first' principles.
Task T012b (Shakespeare partitioning) depends on T011b. Since T011b is invalid (no verified source), T012b has no input artifact to consume. This creates a broken dependency chain in the data-flow.

Task T028 (Generate summary CSV) is listed in Phase 5 but lacks an explicit dependency on the completion of T024a/T024b (Stats) and T025 (Sensitivity). The task description does not mandate running the analysis pipeline first, risking the generation of empty/placeholder data if executed out of order (Consumer before Producer).

Task T001 (Create project structure) is a setup task but lacks a clear 'done' artifact definition (e.g., 'verify tree output'). While not a hard ordering violation, it creates ambiguity in the 'Foundational' phase completion criteria, potentially blocking downstream tasks that rely on the structure existing.

Task T030 (Refactor download.py) is placed in 'Phase N: Polish' but depends on T008, T011, T011b. Since T011b is invalid, this task's dependency chain is broken. Additionally, refactoring error handling (T008) should ideally be part of the foundational setup (Phase 2) to ensure robustness before data download (T011) begins, not as a post-hoc polish.
